novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法——GSAERU 模型。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization—GSAERU model.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩
利用图自编码器学习原图节点的表征
通过循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Modeling the dynamic sequence graph as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each moment
Compressing the original graph through graph summarization technology
Learning the representation of the nodes of the original graph using a graph autoencoder
Learning the feature information and dependencies of the original graph in the time dimension through a recurrent neural network
